LESSON: BIBLE STORY:

Grade: Grade 2

Strand: The By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read 1Samuel 3:3-10 1. Who c
Topic 2.4: Bible Story:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bible Story:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the reasons why God chose Noah to build the Ark and live a 4 lessons
2. narrate the story of Noah and the Ark and relate it to their lives by obeying God and their parents
3. desire to obey God and parents in 28 their daily lives water

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the reasons why God chose Noah to build the Ark and live a 4 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state the reasons why God chose Noah to build the Ark and live a 4 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. narrate the story of Noah and the Ark and relate it to their lives by obeying God and their parents
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to narrate the story of Noah and the Ark and relate it to their lives by obeying God and their parents. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. desire to obey God and parents in 28 their daily lives water
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to obey God and parents in 28 their daily lives water. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bible Story:.
2. Explain Bible Story: to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bible Story:.
4. Show that you can: state the reasons why God chose Noah to build the Ark and live a 4 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bible Story:. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Bible Story: important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. state the reasons why God chose Noah to build the Ark and live a 4 lessons
2. narrate the story of Noah and the Ark and relate it to their lives by obeying God and their parents
3. desire to obey God and parents in 28 their daily lives water

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
